任务操作回执无效，结果尚未确认。请先查询任务。: Invalid task receipt; result unconfirmed. Query the task first.
修订回执未确认，请重新读取已保存修订。: Revision receipt unconfirmed. Read saved revisions again.
无法读取本机的原提交恢复记录。请先核对导入记录并检查浏览器存储，勿重复提交。: Cannot read local submission recovery records. Check import history and browser storage; do not submit again.
无法保存原提交恢复记录。请检查浏览器存储并核对导入记录，勿重复提交。: Cannot save submission recovery records. Check browser storage and import history; do not submit again.
原提交恢复记录不存在，请先核对导入记录。: Original submission recovery record is missing. Check import history first.
TXT/Markdown 不使用页码；其他文件请选择有效页面。: TXT/Markdown has no page numbers. Select valid pages for other formats.
答案卷仅提取已有答案，请关闭自动生成。: Answer sheets extract supplied answers only. Disable answer generation.
服务端尚未配置腾讯文档解析。: Tencent document parsing is not configured.
上传后的文件引用不匹配。: Uploaded file reference does not match.
文件内容与声明大小不一致。: File content differs from its declared size.
服务返回的文件引用不匹配。: The returned file reference does not match.
服务返回的上传地址不匹配。: The returned upload address does not match.
此文件有未确认的原提交，请先使用原请求恢复后再更改范围或用途。: This file has an unconfirmed submission. Recover the original request before changing its range or purpose.
此检查点暂不允许该操作，请刷新任务。: This action is unavailable at the current checkpoint. Refresh the task.
服务模型未配置或检查点不兼容，无法继续。: The model is unconfigured or the checkpoint is incompatible. Cannot continue.
无法读取本机的重新解析恢复记录。请先核对导入记录并检查浏览器存储，勿重复提交。: Cannot read local reparse recovery records. Check import history and browser storage; do not submit again.
无法保存重新解析恢复记录。请检查浏览器存储并核对导入记录，勿重复提交。: Cannot save reparse recovery records. Check browser storage and import history; do not submit again.
重新解析恢复记录不存在，请先核对导入记录。: Reparse recovery record is missing. Check import history first.
此任务有未确认的重新解析，请先沿用原请求恢复。: This task has an unconfirmed reparse. Recover with the original request first.
删除回执无效，结果尚未确认。请先查询任务。: Invalid deletion receipt; result unconfirmed. Query the task first.
任务结果尚不可导出。: Task results are not exportable yet.
请选择当前结果中的题目。: Select questions from the current result.
服务未返回题库 ZIP。: The service did not return a bank ZIP.
无法读取或保存本机校对草稿。请保留当前页面，检查浏览器存储后重试；未确认请求不会: Cannot read or save local correction drafts. Keep this page open, check browser storage and retry. Unconfirmed requests are never resent automatically.
腾讯文档识别后，由 AI 整理题库。超限文件由服务端切分；大 Office 文件: Tencent recognizes the document, then AI structures the bank. The server splits oversized files; oversized Office files require a converter.
解析完成后可直接导入本地题库，保留题目、配图和待复核标记。: Add the parsed result directly to your local banks, preserving questions, images and review flags.
题库已导入，可前往“我的题库”开始练习。: Bank imported. Open My banks to start practising.
筛选仅影响显示，导入仍包含全部已完成题目。: Filters only change the view. Import still includes all completed questions.
模型供应商余额不足，请充值或更换后端模型配置后再手动重试。: The model provider balance is insufficient. Top up or update the backend model configuration, then retry explicitly.
暂停后可导入已完成题目，需有可用题目且检查点一致。: Paused tasks can import completed questions when available and the checkpoint matches.
修订已保存。导入修订版会包含全部已保存修改，原始题库保留。: Revision saved. Importing the revision includes all saved edits and preserves the original bank.
修订版包含全部已保存修改，保留来源与复核标记。任务上方的导入按钮使用原始解析结果: The revision includes all saved edits with source and review flags. The import button above uses the original parse.
此操作尚未完成迁移。: This operation is not yet available in the migrated app.
任务响应无效，请重新读取。: The task response is invalid. Read it again.
无法读取原文修复恢复记录，请核对任务后再操作。: Could not read source repair recovery records. Check the task before proceeding.
无法保存原文修复恢复记录，本次操作未确认。: Could not save source repair recovery records. This operation is unconfirmed.
原文修复恢复记录不存在。: Source repair recovery record does not exist.
原文修复回执无效，请沿用原请求核对。: Invalid source repair receipt. Check using the original request.
已取消选择，原文未修改。: Selection cancelled. The original source is unchanged.
原文已修复，损坏副本及修复清单已保留。: Source repaired. The damaged copy and repair manifest have been retained.
原文校验通过，无需修复。: Source integrity verified. No repair is needed.
修复仅替换为大小和 SHA-256 与最初导入完全一致的文件；不会重新解析或调用: Repair requires a file with the exact original size and SHA-256. It does not parse again or call a model.
保存的原文已丢失。: The saved original source is missing.
保存的原文校验失败。: The saved original source failed integrity checks.
请先停止所有 AI 任务，再重新校验原文。: Stop all AI work, then check source integrity again.
有一笔原文修复尚未确认。重试沿用原请求，不会启动 AI；修复记录和损坏副本会保留: A source repair is unconfirmed. Retry keeps the original request and does not start AI. Repair records and damaged copies are retained.
无法读取任务删除恢复记录，请核对任务后再操作。: Could not read task deletion recovery records. Check the task before proceeding.
无法保存任务删除恢复记录，本次操作未确认。: Could not save task deletion recovery records. This operation is unconfirmed.
删除只清理原任务和检查点，已导入题库、共享原文和用量记录保留。只在你重试时继续，: Deletion removes the original task and checkpoints. Imported banks, shared sources and usage records remain. Cleanup continues only when you retry and does not start AI.
移除本机提示不会撤销已开始的删除。: Dismissing this local notice does not undo deletion already started.
本机任务删除提示已移除，原删除状态保留。: Local deletion notice dismissed. The deletion state is retained.
题库 ZIP 保存回执无效，请检查所选文件后再操作。: Invalid bank ZIP save receipt. Check the selected file before proceeding.
保存的任务结果或检查点无法读取，继续、重试和导出已停用。原文件、调用记录和用量记: The saved result or checkpoint cannot be read. Resume, retry and export are disabled. Original files, call receipts and usage records are retained.
请先恢复损坏文件，再刷新任务详情。也可在其他任务操作中明确重新解析为新任务，可能: Restore the damaged files, then refresh task details. You can also explicitly parse again as a new task under other task actions; provider charges may apply again.
无法读取费用预留，请手动重试。: Could not read cost reservations. Retry manually.
本任务没有费用预留记录。: No cost reservations recorded for this task.
预留是保守估算，不是实际账单；失败和未知结果均保留预留，未启用时的历史调用不补算: Reservations are conservative estimates, not invoices. Failed and unknown outcomes retain reservations; calls made while disabled are not retroactively estimated.
费用预留限额不足。可在任务诊断中读取预留记录，或前往设置核对价格与限额；保存调整: The estimated-cost limit is insufficient. Read reservations in task diagnostics or inspect prices and limits in Settings; after saving changes, explicitly resume the task.
调用预算：预留数未知；任务上限 {0} 次。: Call budget: reserved count unknown; task limit {0}.
部分调用或额度记录无法验证，实际总用量可能未知。继续和重试已停用，原始记录保留。: Some call or allowance records cannot be verified. Total usage may be unknown. Resume and retry are disabled; original records are retained.
